0.heading: Your current site is losing you customers
0.description: Slow load times, poor mobile experience, and outdated design actively drive visitors away. Every second of delay costs you conversions.

1.heading: You're spending weeks on what should take days
1.description: Traditional agencies take months and charge accordingly. You need a page live now to test an idea, launch a campaign, or capture demand.

0.question: How long does it take to build a landing page?
0.answer: Most landing pages are live within 1-2 weeks from kickoff. We start with a design review, build in Next.js, optimize for performance, and deploy to Vercel - all within that timeframe.

wordpressMigration.title: WordPress → Next.js Migration
wordpressMigration.tagline: From slow to instant. In 1–2 weeks.
wordpressMigration.description: We migrate your WordPress site to a blazing-fast Next.js stack - AI-assisted, fixed price, with a 90+ PageSpeed guarantee. No plugin hell, no maintenance burden, just a site that works.

0.heading: Your WordPress site is costing you every day
0.description: Plugin subscriptions, hosting fees, developer bills for routine fixes - WordPress has a hidden monthly tax that never goes away.

1.heading: Slow speed is killing your conversions
1.description: A 3-second load time loses 53% of mobile visitors. Most WordPress sites score 45–65 on PageSpeed. That's money walking out the door.

2.heading: Security patches are a full-time job
2.description: Over 13,000 WordPress vulnerabilities were disclosed last year. Every plugin you run is a potential attack vector. Modern static sites simply don't have this problem.

0.question: Will I lose my SEO rankings during migration?
0.answer: No. We implement 1:1 URL mapping with proper 301 redirects, preserve all meta data, and maintain your sitemap structure. Most clients see rankings improve within weeks due to better performance signals.

1.question: Can I keep my WordPress content workflow?
1.answer: Yes. We can connect a headless CMS that feels similar to WordPress but serves content through Next.js. You keep the familiar editing experience with dramatically better frontend performance.

2.question: How long does a typical migration take?
2.answer: Simple brochure sites: 2-3 weeks. E-commerce or complex sites with custom plugins: 4-6 weeks. We run both sites in parallel during migration so there's zero downtime.

3.question: What happens to my WordPress plugins?
3.answer: We audit each plugin and replace them with modern equivalents. Contact forms become API routes, SEO plugins become built-in Next.js metadata, analytics move to PostHog or GA4, and caching becomes unnecessary with static generation.

seoPerformance.title: SEO, Content & Performance
seoPerformance.tagline: Get found. Load fast. Convert more.
seoPerformance.description: Technical SEO audits, Core Web Vitals optimization, content strategy, and performance engineering that measurably improve your search rankings. SEO is largely content-driven - we combine technical optimization with strategic copywriting and blog articles to build lasting organic visibility.

0.heading: Your site is invisible on Google
0.description: Poor technical SEO, missing meta tags, and slow load times are burying you in search results. Your competitors rank higher because their sites are technically sound, not because their content is better.

1.heading: You have no content strategy
1.description: SEO without content is like a shop with no products. Blog articles, landing page copy, and keyword-targeted pages are what drive organic traffic. Without them, technical optimization alone won't move the needle.

2.heading: You're guessing instead of measuring
2.description: Without proper analytics, error tracking, and performance monitoring, you can't improve what you can't see. You need data to make decisions, not assumptions.

0.question: How quickly will I see results from SEO optimization?
0.answer: Technical improvements like load time and Core Web Vitals show immediate results in Lighthouse. Search ranking improvements typically appear within 4-8 weeks as Google re-indexes your site with the improved signals.

1.question: Do you work with existing websites or only new builds?
1.answer: Both. We can optimize your existing site in place, or recommend a rebuild if the technical debt is too deep. Our WordPress Health Report gives you a clear picture of where your site stands today.

2.question: What tools do you use for SEO analysis?
2.answer: We use Google PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, Google Search Console, Ahrefs for keyword research, and custom monitoring dashboards built with PostHog. All audit results are shared transparently.

3.question: What's a realistic target for my PageSpeed score?
3.answer: Most sites we optimize reach 90+ on desktop and 85+ on mobile. Sites rebuilt in Next.js consistently score 95-100. The exact target depends on your content complexity and third-party scripts.

results.projectedHint: Estimated performance after we rebuild your site with Next.js
results.webVitalsSubtitle: These metrics directly affect how users experience your site and how Google ranks it.

vitalExplanations.FCP: First Contentful Paint - how quickly visitors see the first content. A slow FCP means users stare at a blank screen and are more likely to leave before your page even appears.
vitalExplanations.LCP: Largest Contentful Paint - when the main content becomes visible. If this takes longer than 2.5 seconds, roughly half of mobile visitors will leave before seeing your message.
vitalExplanations.TBT: Total Blocking Time - how long the page is unresponsive to clicks and taps. High blocking time means frustrated users who tap buttons and nothing happens.
vitalExplanations.CLS: Cumulative Layout Shift - how much the page layout jumps around while loading. Shifting content causes users to accidentally click the wrong thing, damaging trust.
vitalExplanations.SI: Speed Index - how quickly the visible area of your page is populated. A slow Speed Index means your site feels sluggish even if it eventually loads.
vitalExplanations.default: This metric affects how users perceive your site's speed and responsiveness.
